main_text.p: rectè obedientibus, & se in via vitæ sequentibus, vitam æternam dandi: non autem, ut Sponsor & Satisfactor, qui suâ Obedientiâ & merito à me satisfecerit, & sanguine suo ita peccata mea expiarit, Christus proponebatur mihi lapsibꝰ meis excruciato, ut Advocatus quidem, sed non talis, qui virtute meriti & satisfactionis suæ, pro me in gratia conservando, intercederet, & ita meas infirmitates ac imperfectiones tegeret; relegabar ad Sanctam Christi obedientiam in vita sectandam, siquidem verè renati carnem suam plane superare possint, ut Spiritus in ipsis nō reluctante carne, sed plane domitâ & subactâ, plenè dominetur, nec Paulus ad Roman. 7.de se renato loquatur, adeoq; in hac vita perfectio fidei & vitæ non sit desperanda. Et hæc quidem scripturarum frequentissimâ allegatione, & mirâ subtiliq; contorsione confidentissimè afferebatur. Quid animi mihi fuerit, reputet secum Christianus, cui cordi est salus, & in his confusionibus salvificæ veritatis seria inquisitio.

page.notes: The page number "230" at the top right is read from the scan and may be partly obscured; the last digit is uncertain. The word "seria" after "veritatis" is read as "seria" but the initial letter is slightly unclear. The reference "ad Roman. 7." is placed at the start of its line in the left margin, and it is set in italic type. The text "de se renato" is therefore read as part of the italic reference line. The abbreviation "lapsibꝰ" follows the printed superscript form.
